key: # One setting per row: key = its name (do not change it); value = what you may edit; notes = what it does.

notes: The public web address, used for share links, the sitemap and link previews in local builds. On GitHub the address comes from the SITE_URL repository variable (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → Variables) or, if that is not set, from the GitHub Pages address.
The current panel number. Change it (and panel_years and previous_panel) when the panel rotates: menus, headings and the link-preview picture follow.
The two years of the current panel.
All times on the site are shown in this time zone.
The Area's Google Calendar (MSCA09). Every meeting and event on the site comes from it.

Leave empty: set the repository secret DRIVE_FOLDER_ID instead (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → Secrets) — the folder id is not published, and a secret is masked in the build logs. It is the id of the Area's shared Google Drive folder that holds documents and flyers; only the automatic Drive listing (with GOOGLE_API_KEY) uses it.
Where site problems and posting requests go.
Area Secretary: where requests for minutes go (motions and Area meetings pages, and the "not posted yet" lines).

value: Mid-Southern California Area Assembly of Alcoholics Anonymous
notes: Business name to search for in Zelle.
Where the site's files live (owner/repository). The "Edit this page" links point here.
